name: Wasabi
title: wasabi.com
shortDescription: Wasabi provides high-performance cloud storage solutions at a fraction of the cost of traditional providers. It is designed for businesses of all sizes needing reliable and affordable data storage. An example use case is the Boston Red Sox using Wasabi for storing and analyzing high-volume video content for advanced analytics.
pros: No fees for egress or API requests
Pricing up to 80% less than competitors
cons: No broader range of cloud services
Potential dependency on a single provider
